source.surface: AI canvas document, three-step flow: before proposal, proposal pending inline, proposal accepted
source.attribution: Flow curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screens.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControl: a check glyph at the tail of the proposed run
decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: small icon-only glyph, no fill, no button chrome
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: small cross glyph of the same size directly beside the check, no fill
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the proposed replacement text is set in green on a pale green highlight; the text it would replace is set in red with a strikethrough; both run inline in the paragraph at once
decisionColour.postAcceptTreatment: the red struck text is deleted, the green highlight is removed, and the surviving sentence is repainted in ordinary body colour with no residual marker
decisionColour.verdict: The pending styling is a temporary marker that is REMOVED at acceptance rather than a success styling that is ADDED. The accepted end state is visually indistinguishable from text that was always there, so the colour never signals approval — only pendingness.
